format: CSV metadata key,value rows; blank row; data header and samples
missing: Source blanks and nan retained; no imputation

field_notes.Subject: Stable pseudonymous participant code, shared across activities
field_notes.Operator: Stable operator code; correspondence excluded from this folder
field_notes.Trial DateTime: Exact recorded capture date/time, with its original precision; not a per-sample timestamp
field_notes.Reference Orientation: Original description retained; not a verified harmonized axis mapping
field_notes.Segmentation: Original declared Elizalde implementation; not a manual gold reference
field_notes.Birthdate: Verified participant YYYY-MM-DD: recorded in this/another capture of the same participant, or explicitly confirmed by the dataset maintainer; never inferred from age

metadata_order: Latest acquisition layout; Birthdate in every capture, no Age field; Trial DateTime last
empty_protocol_fields: Omitted when unavailable, empty or inapplicable, as in the latest acquisition writer; never inferred
personal_date_policy: Birthdate in all 116 captures, consistent across each participant's recordings; source headers remain unchanged in the private archive
